source_title: See Jimmy Fallon and Jamie Lee Curtis Spoof ‘You Can See Everything’
source_excerpt:
Jimmy Fallon and Jamie Lee Curtis spoofed You Can See Everything in a cold open sketch where the host questioned whether the actress wanted to appear on The Tonight Show .
Fallon, as Nathan Fielder, asked Curtis’ Elizabeth Holmes, “Now, be honest. Do you really want to be on the show tonight?” “Of course I do. I love talking to you,” Curtis’ Holmes said in the spoof that mirrored the documentary’s viral teaser trailer .
“So, you’re not just here to promote your new show. Newlyweds ?” Fallon/Fielder asked. “No, I’m engaging with you as a human being,” Curtis/Holmes replied. “Why would I deceive you? There’s no reason for me to do that. It turns out Curtis was in fact there to promote her new show Newlyweds , which the actress both co-created and co-stars in:
Thankfully, The Tonight Show opted to spoof one of the more widely seen scenes from the hit documentary and not spoil one of the three-hour film’s many surprises. “Thirty-four days before she’s sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move,” A24 previously said of You Can See Everything in a synopsis. ” What begins as an intimate portrait of an enigmatic felon becomes a mind-bending three-year journey into the abyss”
